LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 4.3.1PHRASES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar in use 4.3.1Phrases
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 4.3.1Phrases, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use phrases of varied structure in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm the structure of noun phrases Determiner + Noun; Noun + Adjective and present them in a chart. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,

2. listen to an audio recording of a story on careers and identify the noun phrases constituting noun, determiner + noun and determiner+ adjective + noun. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm the structure of noun phrases Determiner + Noun; Noun + Adjective and present them in a chart. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,
2. listen to an audio recording of a story on careers and identify the noun phrases constituting noun, determiner + noun and determiner+ adjective + noun. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 4.3.1Phrases together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
